title: Close the sample Admin design-review routing proof
goal: Prove that a design-manager record can be triaged by Admin, routed to its proposed specialist, and closed without authorizing a product change.

in: Sample review routing and receiving-side closure

resume_condition: Completed evidence-only proof; reopen only if the review contract changes.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The sample identifies the design manager, Admin disposition, proposed specialist, evidence, severity, recommendation, and linked closure task.

evidence: Schema, routing, and linked-task closure validation passed.

progress.summary: Admin triaged the synthetic design review and the proposed specialist verified receiving-side closure. No product code was changed.
